messages:
maria_sales: Heads up — live POC with a UK financial customer. They pinned `redwood-9b-v2` and keep getting `model not available in region` then some 429 spikes. Demo in 45m, can we triage?
jon_se: Need the exact request + any x-request-id from failures. Also confirm tenant id.
maria_sales: Request: `POST /v1/generate {"model":"redwood-9b-v2","region":"eu-west-2"}` Tenant `uk-fin-88`. X-req `req_f12e9`. Errors: `{"error":"model not available in region","code":404}` and intermittent `{"error":"rate_limit_exceeded","retry_after":2}`.
ravi_infra: Quick check: model replica not deployed to eu-west-2 for hosted pins -> 404. 429s likely from shared quota burst.
lucy_sre: I see the log for req_f12e9: catalog returned no-replica, router then hit burst quota 12:10:14-12:10:16 UTC.
maria_sales: Customer also asked about key residency and IP allowlist for a pinned pool.
security-bot: For Dedicated/Private we support UK KMS BYOK and CIDR allowlist. Hosted pinning in region requires Dedicated purchase.
sam_account: Ballpark pricing: to guarantee regional pin + baseline capacity we'd start the commit conversation around $200k/yr for this model class. Will confirm.
ravi_infra: Short term workaround: change request model to `redwood-9b-compat-eu` or enable tenant soft-fallback to compat variants. I'll flip soft-fallback and add a temporary quota bump for 48h.
maria_sales: Flipped, re-ran — 200s now, one 429 at concurrency 12. Demo can proceed. I'll log ticket FIN-2043 for follow-ups (pin request, KMS, quote).
jon_se: Next steps: ops to confirm KMS+CIDR (ravi/security-bot), accounts to send formal quote (sam), infra to propose Dedicated trial if they need strict residency (ravi).
maria_sales: Great, I'll update the customer and schedule a follow-up demo post-contract. :thumbsup:
